question: Mr. Green receives a \(10\%\) raise every year. His salary after four such raises has gone up by what percent?
solution:
Measure salary in units equal to \(1\%\) of Mr. Green's original salary, so his starting salary is \(100\) units. Each raise adds \(10\%\) of his current salary, making the new salary \(1.1\) times the previous salary.

After the four raises, his salary in these units is successively
\[
110,\quad 121,\quad 133.1,\quad 146.41.
\]
Thus the increase is \(146.41-100=46.41\) units out of the original \(100\), or \(46.41\%\). This is more than \(45\%\), so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
